## Safety review

- [ ] No secret can reach output, diagnostics, snapshots or test failures.
- [ ] Resource ownership and cleanup paths were reviewed.
- [ ] No unbounded queue, recursion or retention behavior was introduced.
- [ ] Public API changes include tests, docs, examples and changelog entries.
- [ ] Unsupported platform/backend combinations are reported honestly.
